# Variable `COREBASE_FILES`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

Lists files from the COREBASE directory that should be copied other than the layers listed in the `bblayers.conf` file. The COREBASE_FILES variable allows to copy metadata from the OpenEmbedded build system into the extensible SDK.

Explicitly listing files in COREBASE is needed because it typically contains build directories and other files that should not normally be copied into the extensible SDK. Consequently, the value of COREBASE_FILES is used in order to only copy the files that are actually needed.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-COREBASE_FILES
